personality_one_liner: A high-end, cinematic earning experience where pure minimalist contrast and exquisite gold accents turn micro-transactions into private banking.

spacing.rule: Generous, cinematic spacing. Elements should breathe, highlighting the high-end nature of the app. Never cramp cards.

do's: Use subtle glass over obsidian/cream backgrounds for bottom tabs and sticky headers.
Ensure text on glass is fully readable (use tinted translucent base).
dont's: Do not overuse blur on cards or standard UI sections; rely on the fine gold borders and deep blacks instead.

splash_monogram.alt: Gold minimalist geometric monogram on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a strict Light/Dark mode toggle driven by user input or system preferences, adhering to the Soft Ivory (#FFFFF0)/Cream (#FDFBF7) and Jet Black (#000000)/Obsidian (#121212) palettes. The gold accent (#D4AF37) is identical in both modes.

The typography must rely strictly on Expo-compatible standard/system fonts or local TTFs. Do not use @expo-google-fonts. Use 'Georgia' or 'serif' for display elements (Balance, Logos) and 'System' or 'sans-serif' for standard labels.

For the Splash Screen, implement a Reanimated component featuring a glowing/pulsing gold ring to simulate the trace animation, acting as the foreground while VPN check / storage reads happen behind the scenes.
The Dashboard balance card must have a fine gold border (StyleSheet.hairlineWidth or 1pt max) and the balance text must be expansive (use the 3xl or 48pt equivalent font size).
On the Cashout tab, the PayPal email input must feature a bottom border only ('gold-underlined') – do not wrap it in a fully bordered box.
Ensure 'Request Payout' button logic is disabled strictly when balance is < $5.00, enforcing opacity drop when disabled.
Use tactile Haptic feedback on the 'Watch Ad & Earn', theme toggle, and Cashout buttons. Scale the button down to 0.97 on press.

From Web Research: Luxury finance UI requires high visual space, zero clutter, and strong contrast. Let the Jet Black / Soft Ivory backgrounds bleed edge-to-edge. Use subtle shadows or glass only when absolutely necessary (e.g. for sticky headers or bottom tabs).
